strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Heh heh... I've been waiting... Raideen, Akira Hibiki!
Sharkin! Where's my father... where is he!?
Ugh... A-Akira...
Tch, he's over there?
Mister, can't we rescue him somehow!?
My bid for Super Electromagnetic energy at Nanbara Connection failed,
but this time will be different!
So Sharkin was after Super Electromagnetic energy after all.
But what on earth does he intend to do with that power...?
Have no fear. I too am a proud prince of the Great Demon Empire...
I won't stoop to anything petty!
What are you after, Sharkin!?
If you want to fight me, I'll take you on anytime! Let my father go...!
...You don't seem to understand, Akira Hibiki...
I can't let anyone else have you.
No, to be precise... Raideen...!
What's that mean!? So you took a hostage
just to get Hibiki here before anyone else!?
Hibiki... and Raideen?
Raideen... a relic of the ancient Mu Empire... Is something hidden in it?
When the Einst showed up...
Raideen reacted to them. Does that have something to do with it?
Come to think of it, only that fairy girl and Raideen reacted...
There's no time to think about that now! We have to save Hibiki's dad...!
Are you done talking? Then let us fight...! Come forth, Demon Beasts!
Whoa! A whole bunch of them came out!
Calm down, Beauty. Let's go, everyone!
Hoh... Not bad. Otherwise, claiming the Mutron wouldn't be worth it!
Bastodon! Gardon!
Mutron!? Did he just say Mutron...!?
Mutron... Raideen's power source...?
Now they're sending out the really tough ones...!
At this rate... the super robots will run out of energy...!
Even resupplying has its limits...
If only our forces were in better shape...!
Wha!? Who goes there...!
Th-That's...!
Dammit, took your sweet time, didn't you!
It came for us! Thank goodness!
Ah... Tobikage...!
Bah, what good is a puny robot like that!
Gardon, crush it underfoot!
Ngh... Nnngh... Gah...
This is the end...! Sharkin! Now give me back my father!
N-Not yet... I'm still standing...! I'm not beaten yet, Akira Hibiki!
Here he comes! Finish him off!
You got it!
Everyone, watch out for a last stand! He may have something planned...
...Stay back!
Huh!?
Akira...!?
What gives!? This is our chance!
You're going to let this opening slip by!?
Stop. ...Looks like this isn't our fight.
Thanks, Kyosuke. ...Now, let's settle this... Prince Sharkin!
Heh, heh heh heh heh... Think you can afford to go easy, Akira Hibiki...!?
I'll end this feud with the Demon Empire... me and Raideen...!
You have my thanks, Akira Hibiki...! Now, fight me!
...Gh, guoh...
...Sharkin...!
Did we... win!? What about Raideen!?
By a hair... Well done, Akira...!
Y-Yes... well done... Raideen... And... the Gandor squad.
But... even if I die... my Demon Empire will not fall...!
Sharkin...!
Barao...
Glory... to our great Demon Empiiire!
You did it... Akira...!
Akira...
He had the perfect hostage... and never used him, right to the end.
Sharkin... For an enemy, you were admirable...
Ugh...
Daaaad!
Akira... I've made you worry so much. It must have been hard for so long...
You're the one who... suffered at the enemy's hands...
All right, first we rescue Mr. Ichiro Hibiki. Bluegar, go.
Roger! Akira, your touching reunion will have to wait a bit.
Thanks, Mister.
Heh, it's nice when something finally pays off, isn't it?
Yeah. I hope this makes the Demon Empire fall apart...
...A father, huh.
Tetsuya...
Anyway, let's hurry to the next point.
We've still got a mountain of enemies to fight.
Sigh... seriously.
It's tough being popular.
All right, we'll escort Mr. Hibiki to the Mutron Research Institute,
and the Gandor will head to the next point.
...In the end... we never found out how the Demon Empire is tied to the Einst.
Bara...o...?
Princess?
...No, it's just... as that man fell, I thought it might be someone's name...
